It's surfing competition time down at Goo Lagoon! Choose to play as SpongeBob or Patrick, select your trick routines and match jellyfish to earn points and stay on your surfboard. Charge your trick meter and perform amazing stunts to earn bonus points!

You have three waves to catch, and you have three minutes to perform up to three tricks on each one! Get the highest overall total to beat your rival.

Before each wave, you must choose a routine of 3 tricks. Each trick has a number - you need to charge your trick meter with this many points to perform it. The higher the number, the longer it takes to charge the meter, so choose carefully! If your routine is too ambitious you might run out of time!

The trick number also show many bonus points you can earn.

To choose your routine, simply drag and drop trick icons into the slots on the routine bar. You can choose any combination of unlocked tricks - just drag and drop again to repeat or replace tricks.

Only the easy tricks are unlocked at the start. Complete two easy tricks to unlock a medium trick, worth more points! Complete both medium tricks to unlock the hardest trick!

Your progress will be saved so you can come back later and your tricks are still unlocked.]]> Press the left, down and right arrow keys to match the jellyfish as they pass between the dotted lines to earn 1, 3 or 5 points for each one!

Every jellyfish you get will help charge up your trick meter. (Remember, the harder the trick, the more points it is and the slower your meter will charge) If you miss a jellyfish you will lose some charge... miss too many and you'll fall off your surfboard!

When the trick meter is fully charged, press the up arrow to perform your trick and earn your bonus points. But don't press it too early or you'll wipe out!

Keep an eye on your rival to see how his score is doing - or to laugh at him if he wipes out!
